You are probing a PyInstaller-frozen Python program to reverse-engineer its exact observable behavior.
Run it ONLY as: /workspace/dataset/test19_executable <args>    (never use `python`; it is not available)
The program's source is:

    import argparse
    from bidict import bidict
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--k1', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--v1', type=int, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--k2', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--v2', type=int, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    b1 = bidict({args.k1: args.v1, args.k2: args.v2})
    b2 = b1.copy()
    print(b2)
    b1['new'] = 999
    print(b1)
    print(b2)
    result = b2.inv[args.v1]
    print(result)

Goal: a Node.js reimplementation must match stdout, stderr and exit code character-for-character.
Use bash. Capture stdout and stderr SEPARATELY when it matters, e.g.:
  /workspace/dataset/test19_executable --k1 a --v1 1 --k2 b --v2 2 >/tmp/o.txt 2>/tmp/e.txt; echo "RC=$?"; then inspect with od -c or cat -A.
Run MANY probes (30+). Be systematic and adversarial: hunt for cases where a naive JS port would differ.
Report ONLY hard empirical findings you actually observed, each with the exact command and the exact bytes of output.
Do not speculate about Python internals you did not observe.


Resolve this ONE open question empirically by running the executable. Be exhaustive on this narrow point.

OPEN QUESTION: Surrogate-pair handling in a UTF-16 port: astral printables are emitted RAW (`--k1 <U+1F600>` -> `bidict({'😀': 1, ...})`) and astral non-printables use `\U00hhhhhh` with 8 lowercase hex digits (`--k1 <U+100000>` -> `'\U00100000'`). A JS port iterating UTF-16 code units would test each surrogate half (both Cs -> escaped) and produce `😀`. Confirm the port iterates by code point: `printf '\xf0\x9f\x98\x80' | xargs -0 -I{} /workspace/dataset/test19_executable --k1 {} --v1 1 --k2 zz --v2 2 | head -1 | od -An -tx1` (expect `27 f0 9f 98 80 27`). Also probe a PAIRED lone-surrogate spelled via argv bytes vs a real astral char to be sure the port distinguishes real surrogates (`\udcff` from surrogateescape) from surrogate pairs.

Return the definitive answer with exact commands and exact output bytes (use od -c where escapes matter), plus the implementable rule for a JS port.

# U+10480 OSMANYA ALEF -> UTF-16 D801 DC80  (low half == DC80, inside surrogateescape range)
p "U+10480 (D801 DC80) printable" --k1 $'\xf0\x90\x92\x80' --v1 1 --k2 zz --v2 2
# U+1F480 SKULL -> UTF-16 D83D DC80
p "U+1F480 skull (D83D DC80)"     --k1 $'\xf0\x9f\x92\x80' --v1 1 --k2 zz --v2 2
# U+104FF -> D801 DCFF
p "U+104FF (D801 DCFF)"           --k1 $'\xf0\x90\x93\xbf' --v1 1 --k2 zz --v2 2
# U+1F4FF -> D83D DCFF  (PRAYER BEADS)
p "U+1F4FF beads (D83D DCFF)"     --k1 $'\xf0\x9f\x93\xbf' --v1 1 --k2 zz --v2 2
# non-printable astral whose low half is in DC80..DCFF: U+100080 -> DBC0 DC80
p "U+100080 Co (DBC0 DC80)"       --k1 $'\xf4\x80\x82\x80' --v1 1 --k2 zz --v2 2
# 0xff + U+10480 + 0xff
p "0xff + U+10480 + 0xff"         --k1 $'\xff\xf0\x90\x92\x80\xff' --v1 1 --k2 zz --v2 2
# U+1F480 immediately followed by byte 0x80 (which alone -> \udc80)
p "U+1F480 then byte 0x80"        --k1 $'\xf0\x9f\x92\x80\x80' --v1 1 --k2 zz --v2 2

  xargs -0 /workspace/dataset/test19_executable < /tmp/dt/argv.bin > /tmp/dt/real.txt 2>/tmp/dt/reale.txt
  rc=$?
  node /tmp/dt/ref2.js "$H" > /tmp/dt/mine.txt 2>/dev/null
  realkey=$(head -1 /tmp/dt/real.txt | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n' | sed 's/^62696469637428/ /;s/ 7b//')
  # simpler: extract via cut on bytes
  head -1 /tmp/dt/real.txt | od -An -tx1 -v | tr -d ' \n' > /tmp/dt/rl1
  head -1 /tmp/dt/mine.txt | od -An -tx1 -v | tr -d ' \n' > /tmp/dt/ml1
  RL=$(cat /tmp/dt/rl1); ML=$(cat /tmp/dt/ml1)
  # real line1 = "bidict({" + KEYREPR + ": 1, 'zz': 2})" ; strip prefix/suffix hex
  PRE=6269646963742828 # placeholder
  RK=${RL#62696469637428 7b}
  RK=${RL#626964696374287b}
  RK=${RK%3a2027 7a7a273a20327d290a}
  RK=${RK%3a20277a7a273a20327d290a}
  MK=${ML%0a}
  # mine line1 already just the repr (+newline); real has trailing ": " before 3a2027..
  RK2=${RK%20}
  if [ "$RK2" != "$MK" ]; then echo "MISMATCH #$n hex=$H"; echo "  real=$RK2"; echo "  mine=$MK"; echo "  realtxt=$(head -1 /tmp/dt/real.txt)"; echo "  minetxt=$(head -1 /tmp/dt/mine.txt)"; fail=$((fail+1)); fi
  # line 4 bytes
